headline: S&P 500 Companies Prepare Earnings Reports Amid Shaking Confidence
summary: More than a third of S&P 500 companies are scheduled to report earnings as market confidence cracks amid cautious sentiment.
why: Corporate earnings reports provide fundamental data on profitability and margins, directly driving equity valuations and sector rotations.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: Aggregated quarterly earnings results drive broader market sentiment and equity index direction.

why_moved: Uncertain earnings outlooks and cautious investor sentiment ahead of major corporate reports can trigger volatility across equity indices.
